summary: Comprehensive testing of alfakids educational app completed. Backend APIs: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Core flows working correctly - home page, music tab, login, plans page all functional. Minor icon mapping issue found.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'guitar' is not a valid icon name for family 'ionicons'. The violao instrument uses 'guitar' icon which doesn't exist in Ionicons.
react_native_issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'guitar' to a valid Ionicons name like 'musical-note' or 'mic' in the instrumentIcon function

action_items: Fix icon mapping for 'violao' instrument - change from 'guitar' to valid Ionicons name (e.g., 'musical-note')
critical_code_review_comments: All backend APIs working correctly with proper error handling
All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
React Native components used correctly (View, Text, TouchableOpacity)
MongoDB _id properly excluded from API responses
Auth flow works correctly with JWT tokens
Free songs properly marked and accessible without login
Locked songs correctly redirect to plans page

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows working, 1 minor icon issue)
